scope: Component-specific access, local preparation and redistribution conditions for original TCSExam materials and the listed third-party data, software and runtime components.

Mark a resource unresolved when a trustworthy source or verifiable reconstruction is missing.

resources.decision_scope: Concrete oracle-acceptance answers for 50 tasks and 55 task/variant groups, including solution/precomputed, the HS precomputed archive, JSPLIB scheduling answers and construction solution/Basic.lean proofs. Numeric anchors, checker and scoring configuration, hidden instances, keys, ciphertext, logs, model trajectories, generator/replay source code and test-only duplicate fixtures are outside this retention package.

Future publication requires a separate human release decision, an explicit registry repository and immutable version tag, registry credentials, and the PUBLISH_ORACLE_ANSWERS confirmation argument.
The verified package and explicit publish mechanism do not claim a full oracle judging run or public release approval.
